name: mirage
text: I checked the freshness numbers against the engine's own log, and they are accurate: the old ages are real, not a display error. Details: PropLine's push stream is live, but a push only tells us a line CHANGED. To call an unchanged quote fresh the engine needs PropLine's per-book re-read, and PropLine re-reads some sports slowly: NCAAF every ~11.5 min (last read 526 s ago), MLB ~10.5 min, WNBA ~10 min, against NFL ~100 s, NHL ~110 s, NBA ~220 s. So the NCAAF rows in your screenshot (FanDuel, Pinnacle, Bovada...) are honestly 7-10 min old. NFL and NHL are fine (0 untrusted books). The real gap is NCAAF/MLB/WNBA/tennis. ParlayAPI's streams are connected and hold FanDuel, DraftKings, Bovada and many more, but its NCAAF hot stream is being closed by ParlayAPI after ~19 s, so it is not rescuing NCAAF. I have not changed code yet. Next I am looking at why ParlayAPI closes the NCAAF stream and whether PropLine's slow NCAAF re-read can be sped up on your plan, and I will report back.
